correctness.rationale: All nonnegative boundary cases are covered: the zero-only layer recovers the four zero-gap multiset by successive differences; the three-one polynomial is \(z^{b+c}G_aG_d\) with uniquely readable unordered outer lengths; reversal reduces four candidate assignments to at most two. The remaining one-one polynomials differ by \((G_a-G_d)(G_b-G_c)\), nonzero exactly when both pairs differ. The independent literal-occurrence checker verifies 12,650 weight-three strings of lengths 3–24, but the unrestricted proof is algebraic.
